meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: Claude 会根据 Dieter Rams 的十大设计原则对你的设计进行评分，并生成一份包含证据、评分和结论的报告，最后给出一个可直接使用的 /make-plan 提示，用于创建新设计、优化现有设计或重新设计。
howto.when: 当你要求审核设计，例如说“审核这个设计”、“设计评审”、“检查这个 UI 是否符合 Rams 原则”、“这个 UI 好吗”、“批评这个设计”、“设计审计”，或要求进行应导向计划的批评时触发。

say.text: 审核这个登录页面的设计。
say.note: Claude 会分析页面并输出评分和计划。

say.text: 检查这个 UI 是否符合 Dieter Rams 原则。
say.note: Claude 会逐条评估并给出改进建议。

say.text: 批评这个设计，并给出改进计划。

howto.what_en: Claude audits your design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each with evidence, decides a verdict (new/refine/redesign), and hands off a ready-to-use /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and output scores and a plan.

say_en.text: Check this UI against Dieter Rams principles.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates each principle and suggests improvements.

say_en.text: Critique this design and give a plan.
say_en.note: Claude produces a full report with a /make-plan prompt.
